items.statement: The final reported geometry is checked for stationarity and the report states the imaginary-frequency evidence.
items.expected: A reproducible minimum check is supplied; a bounded failure may instead document the failed check and evidence.

items.statement: The three Sn–butyl carbon pairs are identified explicitly from the final geometry and retained with per-pair context.
items.expected: Exactly three unambiguous Sn–C_Bu pairs with atom indices and distances are reported.

items.statement: The submission reports the signed average one-bond 119Sn–13C_Bu coupling for the supplied structure in Hz.
items.expected: A numeric mean is supplied for success and is compared to the hidden SI/paper reference; bounded failure explains why it is unavailable.
